_about: Region pack for the United States. Patterns are written in plain letters and matched against the folded text of the full posting. Work-authorization statuses used by the rules (profile.json work_authorization.status): citizen, permanent_resident, unrestricted (no rules apply); student_visa (F-1 student, still studying); opt (F-1 on post-completion OPT or the STEM extension); work_visa (employer-tied, e.g. H-1B); needs_sponsorship (outside the US or without status, needs an employer to sponsor).
name: United States

routes.us_on_campus: On-campus job (F-1, up to 20 h/week in term)

route_rules.note: On-campus employment for F-1 students (up to 20 hours a week in term) needs no separate authorization beyond your school's rules (+1)
An internship during your studies needs CPT (curricular training) authorized by your school's designated official before the start date (0)

when.text_re: no (visa )?sponsorship|will not sponsor|unable to sponsor|not (able|willing) to sponsor|without sponsorship

route_rules.note: No sponsorship offered: OPT can cover the first period (12 months, up to 36 for STEM degrees at E-Verify employers) but not a long-term job (-1)
Entry-level role after graduation: Optional Practical Training (12 months; 36 with the STEM extension at an E-Verify employer) (0)
An experienced role needs employer sponsorship (H-1B or similar), which is capped and changes by year: look for employers that sponsor (-2)
Needs employer sponsorship; check whether the employer has sponsored before (-2)

route_default.note: No work-authorization route matched this role: check it before applying (-2)

walls.label: U.S. citizenship or security clearance required
walls.re: (u\.?s\.?|united states) citizen(ship)?\b.{0,25}(required|only|necessary|must)|must be a (u\.?s\.?|united states) citizen|security clearance|secret clearance|\bts/sci\b|public trust|\bitar\b|u\.?s\.? person

walls.label: No visa sponsorship, and the applicant needs one
walls.re: no (visa )?sponsorship|will not (provide )?sponsor|unable to sponsor|not (able|willing) to sponsor|without sponsorship|sponsorship (is )?not (available|offered|provided)

boards.name: LinkedIn
boards.note: Needs a rendered browser (scripts/browser_jd_reader.py). Alerts by e-mail are read by the Gmail pass.

boards.name: Indeed
boards.note: A plain fetch is often refused; use a browser or the Indeed connector.

boards.name: Glassdoor
boards.note: Gives no posting URL: find the employer's own posting before filing it (THE LINK RULE).

boards.name: Handshake
boards.note: Campus recruiting for students and new graduates; needs your school's login, so it is searched by you, not by a script.

boards.name: USAJOBS
boards.note: Federal jobs: most require U.S. citizenship; Pathways internships are for citizens.

boards.name: Employer career sites
boards.note: Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby and SmartRecruiters feeds, polled by job_watch.py from profile/sources.json.

boards.name: H-1B Employer Data Hub
boards.note: Which employers have petitioned for H-1B before. Useful when you need sponsorship.
